study: Heller et al. 2010 (SREE) — Learning Science for Teaching, 3 science-PD arms vs control, electric circuits, grade 4
delivery_evidence: Each PD course was 'eight three-hour sessions completed over a series of...period,' delivered face-to-face by local course facilitators drawn from the field (Methods/Design, p.~3).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is a developer/researcher-made electric-circuits content test administered pre/post (gain score), proximal to the PD content; extraction labels test_type=researcher_made (Findings p.4; Table 8/10).
curriculum_evidence: PD builds teachers' content/PCK for teaching the electric-circuits unit they already teach ('their own classrooms', following the standards-based curriculum they were responsible for); no new curriculum adopted (Design p.3).
outcome_timing_evidence: Student post-test administered within two weeks after the electric-circuits unit in the study year (2007-08); the next-cohort follow-up year was not the extracted wave (timepoint=post, extraction).
